name: @gebeta/js
description: Plain JavaScript SDK for Gebeta Maps (browser)

scripts.build: yarn workspace @gebeta/api build && yarn workspace @gebeta/core build && vite build && vite build --config vite.config.umd.ts && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --skipLibCheck
scripts.lint: test -d src && eslint "src/**/*.{ts,js}" || echo 'No src directory - skipping lint'
scripts.lint:fix: test -d src && eslint "src/**/*.{ts,js}" --fix || echo 'No src directory - skipping lint'
scripts.typecheck: test -d src && (yarn workspace @gebeta/api build && yarn workspace @gebeta/core build && tsc --noEmit) || echo 'No src directory - skipping typecheck'
scripts.format: test -d src && prettier --write "src/**/*.{ts,js}" || echo 'No src directory - skipping format'
scripts.format:check: test -d src && prettier --check "src/**/*.{ts,js}" || echo 'No src directory - skipping format check'
